scripts.dev:source: bun run install:templates:force && bun run --watch --conditions=browser app.ts chat
scripts.chat: bun run install:templates && bun run --conditions=browser app.ts chat
scripts.socket: bun run install:templates && bun run --conditions=browser app.ts socket
scripts.socket:dev: bun run install:templates:force && bun run --watch --conditions=browser app.ts socket
scripts.tui: bun run install:templates && bun run --conditions=browser app.ts tui
scripts.setup: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts setup
scripts.status: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts status
scripts.doctor: bun run install:templates && bun run app.ts doctor
scripts.dev:dist: bun run install:templates:force && bun run build:watch
scripts.docs:check: bun run docs:prompts:check && bun run docs:apifox:check && bun run scripts/test.ts docs
scripts.docker:up: bun run docker:templates && bun run build:binary:docker && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
scripts.docker:dev: bun run docker:up && bun run docker:logs
scripts.docker:chat: bun run docker:up && docker exec -it flyflor-dev /tmp/flyflor-linux chat
scripts.smoke:recovery: bun run scripts/working.memory.recovery.smoke.ts && bun run scripts/mcp.transport.recovery.smoke.ts
scripts.build:watch: bun build --watch --compile --target=bun --packages=bundle --conditions=browser --allow-unresolved="" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'bun'" --outfile dist/flyflor app.ts
scripts.build:binary: bun build --compile --target=bun --packages=bundle --conditions=browser --allow-unresolved="" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'bun'" --outfile dist/flyflor app.ts
scripts.build:binary:linux-arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --packages=bundle --conditions=browser --allow-unresolved="" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'linux-arm64'" --outfile dist/flyflor-linux-arm64 app.ts
scripts.build:binary:linux-x64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --packages=bundle --conditions=browser --allow-unresolved="" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_COMMIT="'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)'" --define process.env.FLYFLOR_BUILD_TARGET="'linux-x64'" --outfile dist/flyflor-linux-x64 app.ts
